mechanism: The ISM Manufacturing PMI is a diffusion index (>50 = expansion). High or rising PMI marks manufacturing expansion and risk-on conditions; low/falling PMI marks contraction. The strategy holds SPY when the PMI signals expansion. PMI is a classic leading indicator of the business cycle.
key_finding: Best search-phase rule uses diff_1m at L0 with OOS Sharpe 1.30 versus buy-and-hold 0.95.
caveats: Winner is search-selected on a single monthly sample and needs holdout validation.
Level thresholds are rolling-percentile based; regime pivots can drift across decades.
Lead estimates rest on a limited number of cycles in the sample.
narrative_summary: ISM Manufacturing PMI is tested as a procyclical growth overlay for SPY — hold equity when the PMI signals expansion.
